mapper.select: SELECT p.tenant_id,p.task_id FROM task_todo_projection p JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.id=p.task_id WHERE p.content_state<>'PURGED' AND p.retain_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM native_search_run n WHERE n.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND n.task_id=p.task_id AND n.phase<>'STOPPED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a LEFT JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=a.worker_id WHERE a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.task_id=p.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE AND (w.id IS NULL OR w.stopped=FALSE)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.task_id=p.task_id AND (r.state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR r.usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (r.state='RESERVED' AND r.category<>'TODO_STORAGE'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invocation i WHERE i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.task_id=p.task_id AND i.state IN ('RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.task_id=p.task_id AND d.state='DISPATCHED') ORDER BY p.retain_until,p.tenant_id,p.task_id LIMIT 32
SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND (state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (state='RESERVED' AND category<>'TODO_STORAGE')) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state='DISPATCHED' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE step SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},response_snapshot=IF(response_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),request_cleanup_state='TODO_PURGED',retained_request_digest=request_digest WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE invocation SET input_snapshot=#{tombstone},output_snapshot=IF(output_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE model_dispatch SET usage_snapshot=IF(usage_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE task SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},goal=#{tombstone},summary=IF(summary IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
UPDATE task_todo_projection SET content_state='PURGED',retained_digests=#{retained} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId}
UPDATE reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{holdId} AND state='RESERVED'
